name: GPT Decoder-Only Transformer
description: Decoder-only Transformer forward pass to logits

data.noteContent:
Decoder-only means there is no encoder to attend to, so the block attends to its own input: the same tensor is wired into both tensor and memory. That is the shape GPT-style models have.

One honest gap: this TransformerDecoder applies no causal mask, so a position can see the whole sequence. Real decoder-only training masks the future out - without that, a language model can read the answer. The graph shows the wiring, not the masking.

The input is a random tensor: the shapes, not a trained model. Tensors here are (seq, batch, d_model) and Print is (2, 10).

decoder-only 的意思是沒有編碼器可以去注意，所以這個區塊注意的是自己的輸入：同一個張量同時接到 tensor 和 memory。GPT 這一類模型就是長這樣。

有一個要說清楚的落差：這個 TransformerDecoder 沒有加因果遮罩，所以每個位置都看得到整個序列。真正的 decoder-only 訓練會把未來遮掉 — 沒遮的話，語言模型等於直接看到答案。這張圖畫的是接線，不是遮罩。

輸入是隨機張量：看的是形狀，不是訓練好的模型。這裡的張量是 (seq, batch, d_model)，Print 是 (2, 10)。

Both edges come from input: tensor is the target sequence, memory is what the cross-attention layer reads. Feeding it its own input turns that layer into a second pass over the same sequence - the node has no self-attention-only mode.

兩條邊都來自 input：tensor 是目標序列，memory 是 cross-attention 那一層要讀的東西。把自己的輸入餵進去，等於讓那一層再對同一段序列注意一次 — 這個節點沒有「只做自注意力」的模式。

Flatten has collapsed 16 steps x 24 dims into 384 features, so this head classifies the whole sequence at once. A language-model head would project each step to the vocabulary and keep the sequence.

Flatten 把 16 步 x 24 維壓成 384 個特徵，所以這個頭是一次分類整段序列。語言模型的頭會改成把每一步各自投影到詞彙表，序列維度留著。
